Implementation evidence before full-suite completion:
- Initial held-out oracle: 4 selected nodes, 0 passed / 4 failed against the pre-fix implementation. Key-set terminal-local cases were falsely reported as would_terminal, and the CLI returned alerting exit 1.
- Candidate validation: held-out oracle 4/4 passed; related bridge-fsck files 14/14 passed.
- Mutation proof: disabling the key-set terminal-status fence made a held-out test fail; restoring the fence returned the oracle green.
- Revert-first test correction: the CLI reducer creates the established .cache.json artifact, so the read-only assertion was narrowed to ignore that cache. The corrected oracle still remained 0/4 RED against the reverted production implementation.
- make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS; production module 611 LOC (<800).
- A clean make test rerun is active; final result pending.
